subject: Trial instrumentation & success criteria — FinWave POC planning
content:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@intrasystems.com>, Luke Harper <luke.harper@finwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Trial instrumentation & success criteria — FinWave POC planning

Hi Ivy / Luke —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we start the trial:  

Summary of ask
- 2-week POC focused on latency/cost and end-to-end visibility for FinWave's document ingestion and retrieval flow.
- Success criteria: 95th perc latency <= 450ms for typical 2k token requests; avg per-token cost reduction target 30% vs current baseline; stable error rate < 0.1% for inference calls.

Observability scope (high level)
- Dashboards: request latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens, error rate, model-switch events, batching efficiency.
- Tracing: distributed traces for ingestion -> model inference -> post-process. Want to see end-to-end spans and KV cache hits.
- Logs: structured inference logs (request_id, model_variant, sequence_length, token_count, latency_ms, error_code).
- Exports: export metrics to your Prometheus instance and logs to your S3 bucket (temporary during the trial).

Owners / roles
- Redwood: Karthik (sales lead) — overall POC coordination; Monica (solutions engineer) — telemetry setup and dashboard builds; Jordan (platform lead) — runtime config and kernel/quantization recommendations.
- FinWave: Ivy (ops) — instrument access and datasets; Luke (engineering) — integration validation; Procurement to loop in SOW/purchase.

Proposed timeline
- Week of Nov 9: access & instrumentation (Prometheus scrape endpoint, tracing collector endpoint, S3 for logs).
- Week of Nov 16: smoke tests + baseline capture (3 days), then tuning (batching/quantization).
- Week of Nov 23: evaluation & handover; final check-in and metrics review.

Attachments: attached a draft SOW and a rough dashboard mockup for discussion.

Immediate asks for FinWave
1) Confirm the Prometheus/trace endpoints you want us to target (or allow Redwood to spin up a temporary collector).
2) Confirm preferred S3 bucket or share temporary write credentials for log export.
3) Any additional success criteria beyond what I listed?

Thanks — I can fold changes into the SOW and Monica/Jordan will pick up the instrumentation work.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


-----Reply — Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@intrasystems.com> -----
From: Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@intrasystems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Harper <luke.harper@finwave.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial instrumentation & success criteria — FinWave POC planning

Thanks Karthik — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side:  

- Prometheus: we can provide a scrape target inside our non-prod VPC, IP: 10.3.21.72 (we'll provide a short-lived peered route).
- Tracing: we use Jaeger; giving you collector endpoint jaeger.finwave.internal:14268 for the POC.
- Logs: we prefer you ship a gzip'ed daily snapshot to s3://finwave-poc-logs (we'll create a write-only IAM role you can assume).

Success criteria additions:
- Trace completeness: at least 90% of requests must have a full trace that includes inference span and downstream DB span.
- Dashboarding: ability to drill from a high-level KPI to the trace and log for a suspicious request within 2 clicks.

Procurement: looping in procurement alias — please share the SOW and estimated cost for the reserved trial.

Ivy
Ivy Chen
SRE Lead, IntraSystems (FinWave Program)


-----Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> -----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@intrasystems.com>, Luke Harper <luke.harper@finwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial instrumentation & success criteria — FinWave POC planning

Great — thanks Ivy. I've captured the endpoints and will start the instrumentation checklist. Quick commitments from our side:  

Monica (SE) action items by Nov 13:
- Configure temporary Jaeger collector -> verify span schema (trace_id, span_id, parent_id, service, name, duration_ms, attributes).
- Create Prometheus job and validate metrics naming (redwood_inference_latency_ms, redwood_inference_tokens, redwood_inference_errors_total).
- Build initial Grafana board with the requested KPIs and the drilldown panels.

Jordan (Platform) action items by Nov 16:
- Enable KV cache logging and per-request sampling to capture cache-hit ratio.
- Deploy a low-risk quantized model variant and run throughput benchmarks.
- Provide a short runtime snapshot (redwood-infra-snapshot.txt) with kernel selections and GPU utilization.

Ivy / Luke — can you confirm who on your side will create the IAM role for s3://finwave-poc-logs and who provides the Jaeger endpoint credentials?

I'll attach the checklist and initial mockup as I finish them.

—Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference


-----Reply — Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> -----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ivy Chen <ivy.chen@intrasystems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial instrumentation & success criteria — FinWave POC planning

Attaching the instrumentation checklist and a short list of metrics we recommend capturing (attached as dashboard-mockup.png and redwood-infra-snapshot.txt). Key items I call out:  

Must-capture metrics:  
- redwood_inference_request_latency_ms_bucket (histogram for p50/p95/p99)
- redwood_inference_tokens_total (counter)
- redwood_inference_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd (gauge computed by our exporter)
- redwood_cache_hit_ratio (gauge)
- redwood_inference_errors_total (counter by error_code)

Tracing: ensure the inference span includes attributes: model_variant, sequence_length, batching_group_id, kv_cache_hit (bool), quantization_level. We will set sampling to 10% for full-span capture and 100% for errors.

I've included the dashboard mockup and runtime snapshot in the attachments. Monica — if the Jaeger collector requires TLS client certs, let me know and I'll coordinate with infra.

—Jordan
Platform Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: dashboard-mockup.png, redwood-infra-snapshot.txt

We prefer an emailed PDF SOW so our procurement system can ingest it.

Thanks,
Luke Harper
